source_findings.normalization: Base forward lines499-523 applies final RMSNorm then casts to input dtype; head consumes returned state (line1325). Local proposal offset must be added AFTER this final norm to admit linear folding. W*Norm(h+b) cannot be folded into Wh+constant.

hypothesis: For postnorm hidden h and frozen future head W_d, real arithmetic gives W_d(h+b_j)=W_d h+c_dj where c_dj=W_d b_j. Precompute c once for each valid future-head/lookahead pair. Runtime still evaluates W_d h and then adds fixed logit bias before native top-k/top-p filtering.

dimensions.valid_pairs_in_current_sampler: For current verified residual depth k>=1 and future d=k+j<=15:14+13+12=39 pairs; initial coarse-seed semantics could change indexing and must be separately specified.

compute_caveat: Does NOT remove any future-head W*h GEMM, target verification forward, acceptance correction or history synchronization. Precomputation removes only a naive extra runtime W*b computation.

Direct W(h+b) already uses just ONE head GEMM. Compared with that implementation, folded form exchanges a1024-element hidden addition for a2048-element logit addition and extra cache traffic; speedup is not implied and it may be slower. If unshifted same-head logits already exist, reuse may help, but must prove same hidden/head provenance.
numerical_contract: BF16 round(h+b) before GEMM differs from round(Wh+precomputed Wb); FP32 precompute/cast choices also alter q. Never claim bitwise equivalence from distributivity.

Keep verifier p unchanged and use the ACTUAL folded implementation q after native stored top_k50/top_p.8 filtering and explicit FP64 normalization for proposal sampling, acceptance p/q and positive residual. Do not sample folded q while accepting against unfurled q.

Offset must never enter verifier stream. Changed proposal distribution alone is compatible with rejection sampling mathematics; finite-precision residual/ties/zero-support remain independently tested, not covered by algebra alone.
heldout_requirements: Freeze fresh training/validation/calibration/evaluation splits before learning b or choosing folded-vs-direct runtime, dtype, tree topology or budget. Do not use existing256benchmark or64capturedrows for such choices.

Fit biases using intended postnorm hidden representation. Test actual runtime folded q on independent held-out free-running states; direct-bias training can be a different finite-precision objective. If tuning quantization-aware/folded objective, declare it and retain untouched held-out set.

First compare target-logit invariance, actual proposal distribution, acceptance/residual oracle and speech quality. Only then measure head cost and fullpipeline C1/C64 with frozen recipe. No acceptance-rate or speed claim is made now.
